name: SDF Domain Manipulation Operators
definition: A set of functions that modify the input position vector `p` in place to create periodic, mirrored, or reflected spatial structures for Signed Distance Functions (SDFs). They partition space into cells and return a cell index for optional use as a random seed.
summary: SDF Domain Manipulation Operators transform input coordinates before SDF evaluation to create patterns, distinguishing themselves by acting on spatial positions rather than distance values.
